senses.gloss: --a son of प्रवीर, the King of the महिषस्. Br. III. ७४. १८७.
(II)--a son of Danu. Vi. I. २१. 4.
--same as शिवपुरम्. M. २८३. १७.
--a शिव temple. Br. IV. 7. २९.
--the देवी; became twins in the २६थ् kalpa. वा. २१. ५९.

(I)--a son of Ugrasena;
1: भा. IX. २४. २४; Br. III. ७१. ३३; M. ४४. ७४; Vi. IV. १४. २०.
a follower of Bali.
2: M. २४५. ३१.
(II)--a son of कृष्ण and सत्या. भा. X. ६१. १३.
(III)--a son of ऊर्जा and वसिष्ठ. Br. II. ११. ४२.
(IV)--one hundred thousand crores. वा. १०१. ९७. [page३-363+ २५]

(I)--the Asura in Tatvalam (Atalam- वा। प्।);
1: Br. II. २०. १६; III. 6. 4; वा. ५०. १६.
one of Danu's sons.
2: Ib. ६८. 4.
(II)--(विघ्नेश्वर); informed महेश्- vara of the medicinal tank of waters created by Maya. Br. IV. ४४. ६६; M. १३६. ४८, ५१.
--created by दक्ष. M. 4. ५२.
--a place sacred to शिव. M. १८१. २७.
--a mother goddess. M. १७९. ३१.
--(शन्खकूट) a Mt. north of the महा- bhadra lake. वा. ३६. ३१; ४२. ६५.
one of Danu's sons. वा. ६८. 4.
--a दानव. Br. III. 6. 4.
--a thousand-hooded snake. M. 6. ४१.
--a son of Danu; a follower of वृत्र in his battle with Indra; joined Bali in the देवासुर battle. भा. VI. 6. ३०; १०. १९; VIII. १०. २१; Vi. I. २१. 4. [page३-364+ २९]
--a son of Danu. M. 6. १७.
(I)--a mountain on the base of Meru. भा. V. १६. २६.
(III)--to be killed by कृष्ण. भा. X. ३७. १६.
(IV)--a mind-born son of जैगीषव्य and Eka- पाटला; attained heaven by tapas. Br. II. ३०. ४०; वा. ७२. १९.
(V)--a यक्ष; a son of पुण्यजनी and मणि- bhadra. Br. III. 7. १२३.
(VI)--one of the eight निधिस् of Kubera. वा. ४१. १०.
--the city of the second talam. वा. ५०. २१. [page३-367+ २९]
--Mt. a hill range on the north of Meru. Vi. II. 2. ३०.
--in शन्खद्वीपम्. वा. ४८. ३२.
(I)--a chief नाग of पाताल. भा. V. २४. ३१; Br. IV. ३३. ३६.
(II)--a follower of Kubera. He seized certain gopis whom कृष्ण recovered. He was pursued and his head cut off. His चूडामणि was presented to बलराम. भा. X. ३४. २५-32.
--a son of वज्रनाभ and father of व्युषि- ताश्व. Br. III. ६३. २०५-6; वा. ८८. २०५.
--a son of वज्रनाभ, and father of युषि- ताश्व. Vi. IV. 4. १०६.

--a region of जम्बुद्वीप; here is Eka- राज्यम् or rule by one, of Mlecchas; here is the hill शन्ख- giri from which flows the शन्खनागा river; the residence of शन्खमुख, the king of नागस्. वा. ४८. १४, ३१-3.
--a R. in the शन्खद्वीपम्. वा. ४८. ३३. [page३-366+ ३२]
--Royal symbols in the arms of a cakra- vartin. Br. II. २९. ८६; वा. ५७. ७९.

(I)--a disciple of लोकाक्षि, an अवतार् of the Lord;
1: वा. २३. १३५.
a राजऋषि.
2: Ib. ५७. १२२.
(II)--a son of Kardama, and लोकपाल of the लोकालोक hill. Vi. II. 8. ८३.
--a sage by garbha. वा. ५९. ९४.
--the king of the नागस् in शन्खद्वीप. वा. ४८. ३३.
--a reptile; (काद्रवेय). Vi. I. २१. २१.
--a daitya in Sutalam. Br. II. २०. २२.
--a Janapada of the भद्रा continent. वा. ४३. २२.
--a शक्ति on the fourth parvan of the Kiri- cakra. Br. IV. २०. १५; ४४. ६०; M. २८६. १०.
--the Goddess from the back portion of नृसिम्ह; follower of वागीशी. M. १७९. २३. ६८.
--a sage of the epoch of Auttama Manu M. 9. १४.
--a son of Vivasvat and छाया; attained the status of a planet by penance; see शनैश्चर. M. ११. 9 and ३८.
(II)--a son of Rudra and सुवर्चला. वा. २७. ४९; Br. II. १०. ७६; ११. २३.
(III)--an आत्रेय. वा. २८. २०.
--the lotus feet of शङ्कर. M. १३. ५७.
--a branch of Angirasa. वा. ६५. १०६.
--the place of शनैश्चर above that of बृहस्पति. वा. ५३. ६०, ९७.
(I)--one of the seven divisions of प्लक्षद्वीप. भा. V. २०. 3.
(II)--a son of आयु. Br. III. 3. २४. [page३-402+ २५]

(III)--a sage: His son went on a pilgrimage on his way to सालिग्राम, he wished to see गन्धमादन, बदरिकाश्रम and others: got frightened by a Gandharva in the form of a tiger which was killed by परशुराम. Him followed the sage. Br. III. २५. ६६-77
(I)--a daughter of दशरथ, and adopted by Citraratha-रोमपाद: married by र्ष्यशृण्ग, (a daughter of दशरथ-Lomapa1da, म्। प्।). भा. IX. २३. 8; M. ४८. ९५; Vi. IV. १८. १८.
(II)--a R. in the Kuru country. Br. II. १८. ७३.
(III)--a daughter of लोमपाद. वा. ९९. १०३.
(IV)--the mother of the sage भरद्वाज. वा. १११. ६०.
(I)--a son of पूर्णोत्सङ्ग, ruled for ५६ years. M. २७३. 4.
(II)--a son of कृष्ण and father of पूर्णोत्- सङ्ग. Vi. IV. २४. ४५.
(III)--a son of अहिमान् and father of शिवश्रित. Vi. IV. २४. ४८.
--a son of मेधातिथि and founder of the शान्तभ(ha)ya kingdom in प्लक्षद्वीप. Br. II. १४. ३६. 8; वा. ३३. ३२; Vi. II. 4. 3 and 5.
--the गोमेदवर्ष of प्लक्षद्वीप. वा. ४९. १३.
--a son of Trikakut (धमसारथि). He realised the आत्मन्. भा. IX. १७. १२. [page३-403+ २४]
--a son of सुबाहु, and father of शतसेन. भा. X. ९०. ३८.
(I)--a daughter of Kardama, married to Athar- वण: दध्यञ्च was her son. यज्ञ was popularised in the world by her. भा. III. २४. २४; IV. 1. ४२.
(II)--a son of दक्षिणा, and a तुषित god. भा. IV. 1. 7-8.
(III)--a daughter of दक्ष, and a wife of Dharma, gave birth to Sukha (क्षेम-वा। प्।). भा. IV. 1. ४९ and ५१; Br. II. 9. ५०, ६१; वा. १०. २५. ३७; Vi. I. 7. २३, ३०.
(IV)--a son of नील, and father of सुशान्ति. भा. IX. २१. ३०-31; Vi. IV. १९. ५७. [page३-404+ २७]
(V)--a son of कृष्ण and कालिन्दी. भा. X. ६१. १४.
(VI)--(Kalpa) author of: a master of Atharva सम्हिता. भा. XII. 7. 4; Br. II. ३५. ६२.
(VII)--a R. in शाल्मलिद्वीप. Br. II. १९. ४६.
(VIII)--a son of तामस Manu. Br. II. ३६. ४९.

(IX)--the Indra of the gods--सुधामान and Viruddhas;
1: Br. IV. 1. ६९.
Indra of the tenth epoch of Manu.
2: Vi. III. 2. २६.
(X)--a कला of Hari. Br. IV. ३५. ९५.
(XI)--a शक्ति. Br. IV. ४४. ७१.

(XII)--to avert impending evils; अभया to get rid of fear, सौम्या to get rid of disease, वैष्णवी against famine and fear from insects and robbers, रौद्री if beasts get sick and die, ब्राह्मी when hetrodoxy prevails, रौद्री for fear of other king's troubles, वायवी for diseases of wind, etc., वारुणी for famines and absence of rains, भार्गवी for fear of curse, etc., प्राजापत्या for miscarriages in delivery, त्वाष्ट्री for bad growth of vegetables, कौमारी for well being of children, आग्नेयी for fear of fire and disobedience, troubles from ser- vants, etc., गान्धर्वि for horses, आन्गिरसि for elephants, [page३-405+ २७] नैऋऋती for fear of ghosts and spirits, याम्या for bad dreams, कौबेरि for loss of wealth, पार्थिवी for loss of trees and lands. These are to be done at particular times of the day when certain नक्षत्रस् like Hasta, स्वाति are in the ascendant. M. २२८. 5-२७.
(XIII)--one of the four fruits of प्राणायाम, the ruin of all sins of the Pitrs and cognates. वा. ११. 6.
(XIV)--(Pracetas): Agni. वा. २९. २७.
--a R. from the lake जया. M. १२१. ७१; वा. ४७. ७१.
--the mantras of the Atharvavedins recited in a ritual connected with digging of tanks. M. ५८. ३७.
--the fifth part of the Atharva सम्हिता. वा. ६१. ५४. Vi. III. 6. १४.
--a mother goddess. M. १७९. २८.
--a daughter of Devaka, and a queen of Vasu- deva. भा. IX. २४. २३ and ५०; Br. III. ७१. १३१ and ६२; वा. ९६. १३०; Vi. IV. १४. १८. [page३-406+ २४]
--(also गीत yogini1); a name of ललिता. Br. IV. १७. ३३: १९. ६२.
--in the गयाशिला. वा. १०८. ४८.
--the most horrible war and तारकामय in the fifth अवतार्। वा. ९७. ७४.
(III)--one of the sons of सुदेवी and विष्- vaksena. वा. ९६. २४२.

(I)--a mind-born son of ब्रह्मा; went on a visit to वैकुण्ठ with his brothers; obstructed by Jaya and Vijaya, cursed them; and this was approved by कृष्ण. His joy to see Hari; the अवतार् of शिव; a son of Kanka; a celi- bate who waits on Hari; went with the latter to पृथु's sacri- fice; was taught the knowledge of yoga by Hari in the form [page३-525+ ४४] of a Hamsa and in the presence of ब्रह्मा;
2: भा. IV. 8. 1: १९. 6. २९ 42; X. ३९. ५३; XI. १३. (whole).
entered उमा- vanam and seeing शिव sporting with उमा, returned.
3: Br. III. ३६. 5 and ५२; ६०. २३; IV. १५. 8 and ४०; ३९. ५६; ४७. ६६.
He and others formed the Sadasyas for Soma's राजसूय;
4: M. २३. २१; १०२. १७; २४५. ७७.
got मोक्ष through ज्ञानम्.
5: वा. २४. ७९.
^1 भा. III. १२. 4; १५. १२-13, ३० and ३४; १६. 1-4, २५-28; वा. 9. ७२; २३. १३१; १०१. ३३७; १०५. 2; Vi. VI. 4. 5.
(II)--आर्षेय Pravara, (भार्गवस्). M. १९५. ४४.
--a son of सन्नतिमान्. वा. ९९. १८९.
(I)--a son of Alarka and father of सुनीथ. Br. III. ६७. ६९; वा. ९२. ६६; Vi. IV. 8. १८-19.

(II)--a daughter of Devala and queen of Brah- madatta, the पाञ्चाल king; she was in one of her previous births the cow of Garga killed by the sons of कौशिक for food during famine. She had great attainments and was a ब्रह्मवादिनी;
1: M. २०. २६.
once she went with the king to the pleasure garden where the latter broke into laughter at the love quarrel between two ants; the queen took it as an insult to her and threatened to leave him; the king after a penance came to recognise his previous birth by the grace of विष्णु and leaving the kingdom to his son retired from the world; the queen who caused all this fell, but ultimately got salva- tion due to her repentence.
2: Ib. २१. १९-24, ३६-40.

(III)--a daughter of दक्ष; wife of Kratu (मरीचि-वि। प्।) (see also Santati and Samtati);
1: वा. १०. २८, ३१; Vi. I. 7. 7, २५.
sons, वाल- khilya sages, ६००० in number.
2: Br. II. 9. ५२; ११. ३६.
(I)--a son of शुचि, and father of ऊर्ध्व- ketu. भा. IX. १३. २२.
(II)--an Angirasa and मन्त्रकृत्; the १२थ् Vedavya1sa. Br. II. ३२. ११०; ३५, ११९.
(III)--a son of ऊर्जवह and father of शकुनि. Br. III. ६४. २०.
(I)--a mind-born son of ब्रह्मा; his visit to विष्णुलोक. भा. III. १२. 4; VII. 1. ३५.
(II)--a ब्रह्मऋषि; water oblation to, after bath. M. १०२. १७.

(I)--a mind-born son of ब्रह्मा;
1: भा. III. १२. 4; वा. 9. ७२; १०१. ३३७.
a son of कङ्क, an अवतार् of शिव; got मोक्ष by ज्ञानम्;
2: Ib. २३. १३१; २४. ७९; ६१. १५५ and १६१.
a Brahma- ऋषि.
3: M. १०२. १७.
[page३-527+ २६]
(II)--an epithet of विष्णु. M. २४८. ३७.

--the eternal dharma of all
1: वा. ५७. ११६.
comprises being faithful, not being covetous, tapas, pity to creatures, control, celibacy, truth, अनुक्रोश, patience and courage.
2: Br. II. ३०. ३७-38; M. १४३. ३२.
--a son of भद्राश्व. M. ४९. 5.
--a R. from the ऋक्ष hills. Br. II. १६. ३१.
--a son of Sumati, and father of कृति(a). भा. IX. २१. २८: M. ४९. ७४; Vi. IV. १९. ४९-50.
--a son of रौद्राश्व. Vi. IV. १९. 2. [page३-531+ ३२]
--a son of त्वष्ट्रि and रचना. भा. VI. 6. ४४.
--giving up of karmas by. Br. II. ३२. ५८; M. १४५. ५४.
--a son of Sumati. वा. ९९. १८९.
--the ninth son of रौद्राश्व. वा. ९९. १२५.
--a son of ऋक्ष; and husband of तपती, and father of Kuru. भा. VI. 6. ४१; VIII. १३. १०; IX. २२. 3-4. M. ५०. २०; वा. ९९. २१४; Vi. IV. १९. ७५-6.

--the capital of कुशध्वज;
1: Br. III. ६४. १९.
also the name of the kingdom.
2: Vi. IV. 5. २९.

--Revealed by विष्णु: taught by Kapila to आसुरि.
1: भा. I. 3. १०; II. 1. 6; V. १८. ३३; M. 3. २९; वा. ३०. २९३.
Here tattvas or first principles are taught. पुरुष the eternal, acts as agent to get things done by the गुणस् of प्रकृति. Its relation to Bhaktiyoga.
2: भा. III. २४. १७; २५. ३१; ch. २६ (whole); २९ 2; वा. ६१. १११.
Its principles are differently enumerated as eleven, five, three and so on; ac- cording to one's युक्ती or reason. Creation of universe ac- cording to सान्ख्य, and the place of प्रकृति and पुरुष therein.
3: भा. XI. २२. 1-२५; भा 24 (whole).
Followed by कृष्ण while ruling from द्वारका and by नारद in his worship of नरनारायण.
4: ch. III. 3. १९; V. १९. १०; IX. 8. १४; X. 8. ४५; XI. १४. २०.
Practised by वैराजसस्;
5: M. १३. 5.
is itself a kind of yoga;
6: Ib. ५२. 3; ११०; १९; १८२. १८; १८३. ४४; वा. ६६. ११०.
born out of the creator.
7: M. १८३. ५०; १८४. २४; २४५. ८७; २४७. 9; २४८. १७; २९१. 2.
--sages of rigid vows: learnt the भाग- वत from कुमार and imparted it to पराशर and बृहस्पति. भा. III. 8. 7-8; M. २००. ११.
--the musala or club of Hari. Vi. V. २२. 7. [page३-583+ २९]
--a son of सत्यभामा and कृष्ण. Br. III. ७१. २४७; वा. ९६. २३८.
--the devas known as वैराजस् live in. वा. ७१. ५२.
--an expiation ceremony for ascetics guilty of sexual act. वा. १८. 8.

--(also सान्दीपन); of काशी, and a resident of Avanti; was the preceptor of कृष्ण and बलराम. Taught them all branches of learning in ६४ days; got back his dead son recovered from the world of Yama (from the sea वि। प्।) by his pupils as गुरुदक्षिण; acted as purohita in the यज्ञस् performed by कृष्ण at कुरुक्षेत्र;
1: भा III. 3. 2; X. ४५. ३१-49; ९०. ४६. Vi. V. २१, १९-31. [2] वा. ९८. ९९.
his concern when कृष्ण and Kucela were caught once in storm and rain.
2: भा X. ८०. ३९-40; Br. III. ७३-79.
--one who has a knowledge of षाड्- गुण्य, knows the language of countries and is skilled in policy. M. २१५. १६.
